screen: /report/<run>#overview and the library home card, full
title: The five headline figure tiles on the Overview carry no trace control, so a committee member cannot reach a source, period or calculation from them.
expected: Every row and figure has one trace control: AGENTS.md reader standard ('one trace control per paragraph, row or figure'), control matrix row CT-047 ('Any paragraph, row or figure's single trace control'), PRODUCT.md principle 3.
actual: Net leverage 2.25x, Gross leverage 2.80x, Interest coverage 4.00x, Revenue $2,250m and Cash $275m show a value, a change against FY2023 and 'FY2024' and nothing else. No control sits inside any tile, clicking a tile opens nothing, and with the Show sources switch on controls are drawn by the bottom line and the two passages but not on the tiles. The library home card shows the same five tiles, also without a trace. The nearest route to the source is Modules > Financial foundation > Show sources on the Leverage chart > Open in Evidence (one passage only) > Evidence > Trace > module > handoff: 5 to 6 clicks, and the calculation register (T4.9) appears only in that last, full view. The tile gives no period dates either: FY2024 is 2023-10-01 to 2024-09-30 (Period table in the handoff), six months before the 'As of 31 March 2025' in the header.
suggested_change: Give each tile the trace of the handoff cell it is read from (the FY2024 cells of Chart data: leverage, interest cover, liquidity and revenue), as the module pages already do for the same cells.

screen: /report/<run>#overview, #modules/CP-4, CP-2A, CP-1, CP-3C, CP-0 and #forecast, full
title: The finished synthetic run shows different values for the same measure on different screens, and nothing states a definition, a period or a reason for the difference.
expected: A measure shows one value, or each value carries its definition, period and basis: PRODUCT.md Positioning ('what a run could not do is stated, not hidden'), AGENTS.md ('Preserve values, periods, units, source references, limitations and analytical conclusions'); the Evidence validation module exists to cross-check modules.
actual: Interest cover: Overview tile 4.00x (FY2024), Key findings claim 3.1x, Legal & covenants current 2.6x, Downside control all-in cover 3.10x. Net leverage: Overview tile 2.25x (FY2024), Legal & covenants current 4.2x, Downside control 1.25x, Forecast FY2025E 1.23x. The USD 1,250m maturity that the contrary-evidence claim rests on falls in FY2028 in Financial foundation (FY2027 'Not supplied: the schedule stops here') and in FY2027 in Refinancing & LME; the analyst's own run note says 'Check the 2028 maturities'. Source readiness says 'Only the synthetic filing is available' and 'Financing terms are absent' while the run holds the filing, an executed agreement and a workbook. Also: EBITDA FY2023 is 400 (T4.4), 410 'Adjusted' (chart) and 410 'Reported' with 430 adjusted (bridge); the Forecast base year (revenue 1,000, debt 600, cash 100) is not the reported FY2024 (2,250, 1,400, 275); the Downside module shocks EBITDA by 10% or 20% with cash interest unchanged or +5%, the Forecast by 20% with rates +10%; the Debt stack adds to 2,000 (4.0x cumulative) against total debt of 1,400 (2.80x); a Minimum liquidity covenant of 100 US$m is shown that the agreement (Sections 1 and 2 only) does not contain. Twelve modules' Contrary evidence sections all say 'Nothing supplied contradicts the view'. The cause is the canned handoffs in proof/handoffs/, which contradict one another; no screen flags any of it.
suggested_change: Make the canned handoffs agree (one cover and one net leverage with a stated basis, one maturity year, a CP-0 that matches the three uploaded files, one downside definition) so the proof is a coherent demonstration. Whether the library should show unreconciled values across modules is the owner's decision, because delivery adds no analysis.

title: The Forecast page's Forecast assumptions section shows 'Observed | Not supplied: nothing to report', and the page never states the downside shock or the drivers the numbers rest on.
expected: The page outline lists 'Assumptions'; a reader judging the Downside shock case needs its size. AGENTS.md: delivery selects module-written passages with every number and qualification exact; the handoff records base_drivers and downside_shock (proof/handoffs/CP-2G.md:75-79).
actual: Expanding Forecast assumptions shows a one-row table 'Observed | Not supplied: nothing to report'. The Downside shock card says only 'a shock applied to the base-case drivers'. The page states neither the shock (EBITDA -20%, rate +10%) nor the tax and working capital driver (10% of revenue, which turns the base operands' 30 into 105 in FY2025E) nor the 6% interest rate. They exist only as a raw JSON block in the Forward credit model handoff, reached by Show sources > Open in Evidence (line 93); the Evidence Trace tab's full view of that handoff omits the block. The Downside module uses a different shock (-10% or -20% EBITDA, cash interest +0 or +5%), so two downsides are on screen. The periods are also undefined on the page: the JSON gives forecast years 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31 and so on, while the reported FY2024 is 2023-10-01 to 2024-09-30, yet both are labelled FY with no dates shown. Recomputing the forecast from the JSON gives the page's numbers (172.46 and 97.47 for FY2027E), so the arithmetic is right; the reader cannot see what it assumes.
suggested_change: Draw the recorded base drivers and the downside shock in the Assumptions section (name, values by year, category, rationale) instead of the register 'Observed | Not supplied', and state the shock on the Downside shock case card.

title: Evidence Sources and Gaps do not surface citations that match no source file, and Sources says each uploaded file is named in a handoff by all 14 modules.
expected: What a run could not do is stated, not hidden (PRODUCT.md Positioning); the Evidence page draws source references, file names and gap ledgers (AGENTS.md). Matrix CT-046 (Evidence tabs).
actual: The Key findings drawer says 'annual.txt p.2 · not in inventory'. The 14 handoff bodies cite annual.txt 38 times (25 in Financial foundation) plus 'Filing p.1', 'Memo' and 'Synthetic p.1'. Sources lists only the three uploaded files, under the heading 'Named in a handoff', each against all 14 modules, and says nothing of annual.txt. Gaps shows 'Gaps 0 / This run lists no gaps.' The module lists are true only of each handoff's '## Sources' header (the files the launcher sent); the bodies name northbridge-filing.txt once (Rates, FX & hedging) and the agreement and workbook never. A committee member checking where a figure comes from is told that every file backs every module and that nothing is missing; only the single drawer says otherwise.
suggested_change: List on Sources the file names the handoffs cite that match no uploaded file ('Cited, not supplied'), count them on Gaps, and relabel the module list 'Sent to' or list only the modules whose bodies cite the file.

title: The Confidence score (89, High) is right but its method is shown nowhere, and its trace drawer lists fourteen 'the row cites no page or register' lines.
expected: A derived figure shows how it was derived: AGENTS.md reader standard ('every paragraph, row and figure traces'); the module's own method is fixed by ruling (matrix CT-049) but must be visible to be checked; docs/rulings/2026-11-11-reader-and-issuer-report.md.
actual: Every module page shows 'Confidence score 89 High' (all 14 handoffs carry the same inputs). The drawer repeats 'no page / the row cites no page or register' fourteen times for the inputs table and gives no weights, source-gate factor, coverage share or penalty. Recomputed by hand from the table (lineage 8 / 2 / 2, weights 1.0 / 0.9 / 0.5, evidence 90; fields 95 of 100; gate pass; one minor finding at 3 points): (0.6 x 90 + 0.4 x 95) - 3 = 89, so the value is right; the person cannot do this from the screen.
suggested_change: State the method in the score's drawer (the lineage weights, the 60/40 split between evidence and field coverage, the gate factor and the penalties) and replace the fourteen 'no page' lines with the inputs table itself.

title: The issuer calendar counts one dated event once per module that repeats it, and the Overview's Dates to watch lists one event five times.
expected: The count in a chart header equals the number of distinct events the chart draws, and a reader who has not read the sources is not told of events that are one event repeated (AGENTS.md reader standard; PRODUCT.md principle 4, exact values survive every boundary).
actual: The calendar header says 'Historical 9, Scheduled 18, Scenario 9' (36 events). The 14 handoffs carry 36 event rows for 4 distinct events (2025-03-31 Synthetic note, 2025-06 Synthetic call, 2025-Q3 Synthetic review, 2026 Synthetic maturity), each repeated by nine modules and listed nine times with the module's name. The Overview's Dates to watch shows the 2025-03-31 'Synthetic note' five times. In a real run, several modules citing the same maturity would inflate the counts the same way.
suggested_change: Merge rows with the same date, event and status into one row that lists the modules that reported it, and count merged events.

screen: /report/<run>#overview and the library home card, full
title: The Overview draws five of its six headline tiles and drops Adjusted EBITDA without saying the figure was not supplied.
expected: Missing is stated, never hidden or shown as zero: PRODUCT.md Positioning; AGENTS.md ('Preserve ... missing versus zero'); the Financial foundation page does state it.
actual: The Overview shows Net leverage, Gross leverage, Interest coverage, Revenue and Cash. There is no EBITDA tile and no note about one; the word EBITDA does not appear on the page. The handoff's 'Chart data: revenue and EBITDA' has FY2024 Adjusted EBITDA 'Not supplied: the measure is not stated', and the Financial foundation page shows n.a. and the reason. The leverage and coverage tiles divide by an EBITDA the Overview never shows. The tile list drops any measure whose latest value is missing (HeadlineFigures.tsx:17).
suggested_change: Draw the tile with 'Not supplied' and its reason (as the Financial foundation page does) instead of dropping it.

title: The rating's as-of date (2025-02-28) is only in a hover title on a non-focusable element, so it is not visible on a touch screen or by keyboard.
expected: Information is available without a pointer: PRODUCT.md Accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA working assumption). The analyst entered the date at run start and the card is the only place the rating is shown.
actual: The card reads 'Moody's B1 Negative / Entered at run start'. The date exists only as title='as of 2025-02-28' on the list item (no tabindex); the date appears in no visible text on the Overview, Evidence or Run record.
suggested_change: Print the as-of date (and scope) in the card's text.

title: The Forecast page prose names module codes (CP-1, CP-2G) and says 'Python's arithmetic'.
expected: Ids and run codes are drawn only on the Evidence page and in the trace drawer; the reader is a committee member who has not read the sources (AGENTS.md reader standard; PRODUCT.md Capabilities and Constraints).
actual: Model limitations reads 'Every figure is Python's arithmetic over inputs the CP-2G handoff stated; the inputs, not the arithmetic, are unreviewed' and 'The last twelve months could not be built from the periods CP-1 prints'; a note reads 'the latest period CP-1 labels'.
suggested_change: Say 'the forward credit model's inputs' and 'Financial foundation' and drop 'Python's'.

title: Several trace controls on one page share the same accessible name, so a screen-reader user cannot tell which row or passage each opens.
expected: A control's name says what it acts on (WCAG 2.2 2.4.6; PRODUCT.md Accessibility).
actual: Overview: 'Show sources for this passage' x2 (Key findings and Contrary evidence). Forecast: 'Show sources for Cash proxy by scenario' x3. Financial foundation: 'Show sources for FY2024' x2 (Net debt data and Debt principal rows).
suggested_change: Name row controls with the table and the row ('Net debt data, FY2024') and passage controls with their section heading.

title: The Script checks tab shows 215 although 205 of the checks did not run.
expected: A count on a tab reflects what the reader will find under it: reader standard in AGENTS.md; what a run could not do is stated, not hidden (PRODUCT.md).
actual: The badge reads 215. By module the page shows 205 'not checked', 9 'agreed' and 1 'noted'. A reader taking 215 as checks passed is misled; the per-module lines are accurate.
suggested_change: Show 'ran 10 of 215' or count only the checks that ran.

title: The model and calculation downloads give a committee member nothing to recompute the reported ratios.
expected: AGENTS.md: 'The HTML Model, charts and calculation JSON are parts of that issuer report'; matrix CT-048 (download handoffs, calculation JSON, the Model).
actual: 'Annual model handoff' is annual.md, byte-identical to the Financial foundation handoff (sha256 d501fa95...). The Calculation JSON has annual_periods [] and values {}, and every amount in its history is null with the reason 'the forecast inputs do not name the row and period of this line'. 'The original HTML Model is unavailable for this run.' The calculation of the reported ratios is available only as the T4.9 register in the full handoff view. This is the synthetic proof run; a live run may differ.

title: The same measure carries different names on different screens, and similar names stand for different measures.
expected: One name per measure across the library, so a reader can follow a figure from the Overview to the module and the Forecast (harmony rule; AGENTS.md reader standard).
actual: Debt over EBITDA is 'Gross leverage' on the Overview, 'Total debt / EBITDA' on Financial foundation and 'Total leverage (debt / Adj EBITDA)' on the Forecast. EBITDA over cash interest is 'Interest coverage' on the Overview, 'Interest cover' on Financial foundation and Legal & covenants, and 'Interest coverage (Adj EBITDA / interest)' on the Forecast, while the Downside module's 'All-in cover (x)' is a different measure. None of the Overview tile names carries its formula.
suggested_change: Use one label per measure, taken from the handoff's own metric name, and show the formula in the tile's trace.

title: The 14 modules are listed in a different order on the Overview than in the Modules navigator and the Evidence filter, and the Overview lists 13.
expected: One module order across the library so a reader moves between the Overview list, the Modules navigator and the Evidence filter without re-finding a module (harmony rule); matrix CT-044 (choosing a module).
actual: Overview 'Bottom line by module' follows the run order (Source readiness, Financial foundation, Business & governance, Research questions, Legal & covenants, Fundamental credit, Downside, Rates FX & hedging, Liquidity, Forward credit model, Refinancing & LME, Security selection, Evidence validation) and omits Committee decision, whose bottom line is the headline. The Modules navigator and the Evidence module filter use another order (Fundamental credit, Downside, Liquidity, Rates FX & hedging, Forward credit model, Security selection, Refinancing & LME, Legal & covenants, Evidence validation, Committee decision, Research questions last). Liquidity and Rates FX & hedging, and Refinancing and Security selection, swap places between the lists.
suggested_change: Use one order everywhere, and say on the Overview that the Committee decision's bottom line is the headline above.
